messages:
maria (Support): FYI customer reported a regression in JSON-mode after yesterday's model swap to redwood-mosaic-v2-q4. their app started failing JSON.parse on our responses. tagging @kai to triage.

maria (Support): Error from their client: 
```
SyntaxError: Unexpected token , in JSON at position 234
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at parseResponse (app.js:42:18)
```

maria (Support): They pasted a few examples where keys are missing or wrapped differently and sometimes the model emits plain text outside the JSON block. repro steps are included below.

sophie (Customer): hitting our occupation endpoint, previously we always got `{ "user_id": "123", "intent": "book_flight", "entities": [...] }` but after the upgrade we intermittently get: `{ "payload": "{\"id\":\"123\",\"intent\":\"book_flight\"}", }` (notice trailing comma + string-wrapped JSON) which crashes our parser. This started ~2026-03-18 02:10 UTC when the swap happened.

maria (Support): repro steps I used: 
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
   -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' 
   -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
   -d '{"model":"redwood-mosaic-v2-q4","mode":"json","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"classify_intent: {\"text\":\"I need a flight\"}"}] }' 
2) occasionally get well-formed JSON, sometimes get extra wrapping or trailing comma. small sample below.

maria (Support): Sample failing response (exact bytes): 
```
{"id":"resp_abc","choices":[{"message":{"content":"{\"payload\": \"{\\\"user_id\\\":\\\"123\\\",\\\"intent\\\":\\\"book_flight\\\"}\", }"}}],"model":"redwood-mosaic-v2-q4"}
```

kai (Eng-runtime): thanks, can you paste the raw request (headers + body) and the model name + commit hash we rolled? also any rate/latency differences? might be a change in the post-processing or tokenizer that affects streaming chunk boundaries.

maria (Support): headers: `Authorization` present, `Accept: application/json`. rate: customer is low qps (2-3 r/s). latency sometimes spikes to 800-1200ms while working fine before (avg ~160ms). model tag: redwood-mosaic-v2-q4 @ commit `a3f9d2c` (per deploy-bot).

deploy-bot: deployed redwood-mosaic-v2-q4 to hosted-prod at 1768999800 by andre (ModelOps) - canary 5% -> 100% completed, rollback=false, notes="quantized kernels, aggressive token merging"

andre (ModelOps): I pushed that quantized build last night, notes included an aggressive post-processing step to collapse consecutive punctuation and to attempt JSON cleanup heuristics. didn't expect it to wrap JSON in strings but could be a bug in the cleanup when the model emits backticks or escapes. i'll repro locally with the exact prompt.

kai (Eng-runtime): likely causes: (a) streaming chunk merge logic placed chunks inside quotes, (b) post-processing heuristic mistakenly double-escaped JSON payloads, or (c) model changed to sometimes output an outer wrapper `payload` string. can you attach raw bytes and an exact curl (including escaped quotes)? i'll run the same across canary and stable to compare.

maria (Support): attaching raw bytes below (copied from customer's logs):

kai (Eng-runtime): good raw dump. that definitely looks like double-escaping plus a trailing comma inserted by the cleanup heuristic. next steps: (1) andrew/andre to reproduce with `a3f9d2c` and the exact prompt; (2) i'll add a togglable flag to the post-processing to disable aggressive cleanup on canary; (3) support to ask customer for temporary retry with `mode=json` -> `mode=structured` fallback to see if older formatting path avoids double-escaping.

andre (ModelOps): reproducing now. preliminary glance: our post-processing regex `s/\,\s*\}$/}/` is too eager and runs after an escaping pass which can leave `\"` sequences. i'll push a fix to only strip top-level commas when not inside quotes. can push hotfix to canary within 30m.

maria (Support): customer willing to test a canary build if we provide an endpoint. they need this fixed ASAP; it's breaking their production parser and causing billing regressions because they replay failed requests which double-count. reporting priority P0.

kai (Eng-runtime): i'll prepare a canary route with cleanup disabled and hand off to you, @maria. please collect a few example request ids and times so we can correlate logs. also enabling extra tracing for streaming boundaries.

maria (Support): collecting ids now, will DM. thanks. :thumbsup:

andre (ModelOps): hotfix pushed to canary at 1769002800, rolling to 10% with cleanup toggle off. will monitor errors and send rollback if not green.

maria (Support): customer confirmed reduced JSON.parse failures on the canary endpoint after testing 20 requests. will coordinate for full rollout once metrics stable.

kai (Eng-runtime): action items: andre to land robust regex fix + unit tests, andrew to add flag around cleanup, runtime to add streaming boundary tests to avoid inserting quotes across chunk merges, support to monitor customer and confirm resolution. closing loop after stable rollout.

maria (Support): noted, thanks everyone.
